summary: Two bounded COFACTORS-015 author candidates are complete, pending the separate critic and finite experimenter. Candidate 1 refutes the exact raw equal-cofactor global-label bound, with shortest four-label raw paths at N=16, the supplied N=30 witness and a separately scoped rectangular product toy. It proves that restricting the full pullback comparison to integer cofactors gives |M1| times the raw kernel, and that the positive-product modular cofactor sector c=1 is the protected h=1 block with an explicit noncontracting eigenmode. This statement is confined to its configuration Hilbert space and is not a lower bound for the different source operator or its factorable Vaughan inputs. Candidate 2 proposes an explicit positive single-prime center gamma_h, retains gamma_1 asymptotic to the Goldbach scale, and proves the harmonic cofactor Cauchy reduction with bounded reciprocal test mass. Its sufficient weighted dispersion estimate D remains unproved and already includes the unknown prime atom. Independently within that candidate, a fixed fourth-power polynomial-marking argument proves a bounded unnormalized eighth character moment and a polylogarithmic one-spaced exceptional-set bound, with repeated primes, fixed twists, normalizers and polynomial heights explicit. No polynomial-label operator transport, full energy extension, original prime margin, actual Goldbach consequence or novelty is claimed. All COFACTORS-015 mathematics was written without helper code execution; assurance is author derivation pending separate review. Usage is unknown.
